verdict.rationale: Docs show that external BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Sigma) can query Databricks metric views directly, and a JDBC-style connection library (Databricks Connect) is documented, indicating standard driver-based BI connectivity without custom glue. However, no dedicated JDBC/ODBC driver certification page or explicit ODBC integration guide is cited in the pack. missing for 10: a direct JDBC/ODBC driver download/certification doc, independent BI-tool hands-on validation.
